tests.name: System Information
tests.description: Gathers basic system information

tests.name: Kernel Version Check
tests.description: Verifies the running kernel meets a minimum version requirement

tests.name: Firewall Status Check
tests.description: Checks UFW, iptables and nftables firewall status and rules

tests.name: Security Updates Check
tests.description: Checks for pending security and system updates

tests.name: Home Directory Permissions Check
tests.description: Audits permissions on home directories and .ssh folders

tests.name: MAC System Check
tests.description: Verifies SELinux or AppArmor is enabled and enforcing

tests.name: Password Policy Check
tests.description: Checks /etc/login.defs and PAM for password length, expiry and complexity rules

tests.name: SSH Configuration Check
tests.description: Audits sshd_config for insecure settings (root login, password auth, X11, etc.)

tests.name: Open Ports Check
tests.description: Lists all listening ports and flags unexpected or sensitive services

tests.name: SUID/SGID Files Check
tests.description: Scans for SUID/SGID binaries and flags unknown ones against a whitelist

tests.name: User Accounts Audit
tests.description: Audits user accounts: UID 0, empty passwords, service account shells, sudo/NOPASSWD, duplicate UIDs

tests.name: Cron Jobs Audit
tests.description: Audits cron jobs for dangerous permissions, unowned files and suspicious commands

tests.name: Filesystem Security Check
tests.description: Verifies mount options for /tmp, /home and removable media (noexec, nosuid, nodev)

tests.name: Sysctl Security Parameters Check
tests.description: Checks kernel hardening sysctl parameters (ASLR, SYN cookies, IP forwarding, ICMP, etc.)

tests.name: Running Services Audit
tests.description: Enumerates running services and flags unnecessary or dangerous ones (telnet, FTP, rsh, etc.)

tests.name: Audit Logging Configuration
tests.description: Checks auditd, syslog and log rotation are active with sensible rules

tests.name: World-Writable Files Check
tests.description: Scans system directories for world-writable files

tests.name: Disk Encryption Check
tests.description: Detects LUKS, dm-crypt and ecryptfs disk/home encryption and checks swap

tests.name: Installed Packages Check
tests.description: Audits installed packages for dangerous/legacy software and optionally runs debsecan

tests.name: Suspicious Process Check
tests.description: Detekcia skrytých PID, procesov so zmazanou binárkou a procesov spustených z podozrivých adresárov (/tmp, /dev/shm)

tests.name: Docker Container Security Check
tests.description: Kontrola bezpečnosti Docker/Podman: privilegované kontajnery, Docker socket mount, zdieľané namespaces, limity zdrojov, daemon.json

tests.name: Backup Verification Check
tests.description: Overenie existencie a čerstvosti záloh (rsnapshot, borg, restic, bacula, timeshift). Vyžaduje zálohu mladšiu ako max_backup_age_days.

tests.name: TLS and Crypto Configuration Check
tests.description: Kontrola kryptografickej konfigurácie: systémová crypto politika, MinProtocol TLS, slabé SSH šifry/MAC/KEX, expirácia certifikátov.
